notes: Polkadot's initial supply was 1B DOT post-redenomination.
Inflation has evolved through three phases:
2. Nov 2024 to March 2026: Fixed annual emission of 120M DOT.
3. March 2026 onwards: Hard supply cap of 2.1B DOT. Inflation decreases every 2 years by 13.14% of the remaining gap to the cap.
Staking Rewards (85%) and Treasury (15%) splits are maintained across phases based on late 2024 economic reforms.
